publicReleaseNotes:
**The install and deployment guides now explain which rer version the checkout runs.** They point to the exact pin in `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and explain that `rer --version` shows the installed CLI first and the checkout's pin second. After dependencies are installed, commands run the checkout's pin. Lamp keeps rer 0.2.118.

Upgrading from 1.11.19: back up data and your source changes first, update the checkout to `v1.11.20`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations or contract meaning changes. Keep the backup, exercise a restored copy and check your installation's sign-in, first-run, Settings, incident and maintenance workflows and intended mail configuration. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and account credentials for `rer signin`. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including the migration introduced in 1.11.17, the mail-off instructions in 1.11.19 and keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.
agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.19: back up data and owner source first, update the checkout to v1.11.20, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout keeps @runeditrun/rer exactly 0.2.118) and rer deploy with the same environment and input file. This release adds no migrations or contract meaning changes. The guides now identify the checkout pin and distinguish it from the installed CLI version. Preserve the original deployment checkout, recorded ownership and Cloudflare account credentials for guarded rer signin to the selected environment's app Worker. Preserve the intended enabled or disabled mail configuration; for deliberate MAIL_PROVIDER=none follow the retained 1.11.19 notes and docs/deploy.md, including removal of conflicting sender, sending credentials, relay settings, DKIM inputs and secondary mail-provider configuration. Keep the pre-upgrade backup, exercise a restored copy and check sign-in, first-run, Settings, incident and maintenance workflows. Earlier installations follow the retained release-history records through 1.11.19, including the 0081 migration introduced in 1.11.17 and INSTALLATION_KEY custody. Preserve all published release records, immutable contract snapshots, applied migration history, owner customizations and recorded Worker names and hosting inputs. Run the existing verifier, release validator and affected owner workflows before adopting.
